requiredFindings.title: Bind dirty edits to the exact qualification snapshot revision they were reviewed against
requiredFindings.finding: The dirty-form rule protects locally changed fields but says submitting still uses the server revision without binding that revision to the complete snapshot underlying the edit buffer. A late newer read or status observation can therefore be interpreted as advancing expected_revision while retaining old full-set values. The existing PATCH accepts a complete six-field replacement; the generic no-automatic-merge wording does not resolve this revision-only rebase.
requiredFindings.concreteScenario: User loads revision10 and edits desired_outcome. Another admitted correction changes organization at revision11. A delayed read11 arrives while the local buffer still contains revision10 organization. If Continue correction adopts server revision11 without replacing/reviewing the complete base, set_qualification with expected_revision11 can succeed and silently restore the old organization, although no automatic fieldwise merge occurred.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Track a distinct edit-buffer base revision and complete reviewed snapshot. A delayed read/status response must not advance that base or the operation expected_revision. Continuing the old correction submits its original reviewed base and receives stale refusal if current authority advanced; alternatively require explicit installation/review of the complete newer snapshot and deliberate resolution/re-entry of retained edits before creating a newly confirmed command. Do not automatically copy old fields onto a newer revision. Specify that an already sent or uncertain operation keeps its exact original operation identity/expected_revision/typed meaning and is reconciled separately.
requiredFindings.futureBehaviorOracle: With dirty revision10 and concurrent revision11 changing a different field, a late read11 cannot produce an unreviewed successful full-set overwrite. Assert original-base stale rejection or explicit complete newer-base review and conflict resolution; mutation-reconciliation identity remains unchanged for a sent/uncertain command.
requiredFindings.boundary: This is a local logical refinement under existing optimistic-revision/full-set mutation authority, not a new founder product choice. No handler or schema test is required for the prose correction; later actual GET/PATCH/browser concurrency tests must exercise it.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Cause and route candidate
reviewedAssessments.assessment: The UX already requires supplied qualification redisplay/correction at FLOWS165-169; INTERFACE594-599 expressly leaves authorized read delivery undefined. Existing status and mutation receipts omit the personal field set. A separately proposed GET on the existing qualification resource is a coherent logical design option. IF-BOOK-10 remains unallocated/proposed, not a deployed or approved catalogue route.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Closed pre-intent purpose and state scope
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Allowed states alone do not authorize disclosure. Proposal additionally requires an admitted lawful complete qualification, live own-lineage booking-family proof and current purpose, with no admitted/unresolved calendar or meeting intent. VALIDATION_ERROR can expose a still-lawful prior valid record; initial invalid input cannot manufacture stored data. Later confirmed/reschedule/cancel review paths remain separate and are not certified here.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Authority and output fence
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Current proof family/generation/lineage and purpose/retention checks at lookup/output exclude UUID, email verification, chat/staff identity or old receipt as authority. Coherent committed revision plus rechecked output fence addresses correction/withdrawal/revocation/expiry/intent-admission races logically. Concrete cross-worker serialization, streaming/delivery ordering and physical enforcement remain implementation bindings, not proved by a GET design.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Projection and schema reuse
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Exactly six existing qualification values and minimal applicable recorded purpose/notice reference are proposed; no extra question/budget, raw grant history, challenge/provider/staff data, secret or timestamps are added. Existing qualification definition is closed with required six fields; read must preserve admitted stored normalization and cannot treat schema shape as current eligibility/mailbox/permission proof. Exact closed response/error and consent-reference encoding is still future work.

reviewedAssessments.subject: No extra effects or retention
reviewedAssessments.assessment: GET does not issue proof/CSRF, renew access/consent/field expiry, allocate lineage, submit/retry/reconcile provider work, verify email or schedule. Per-origin copy expiry and disclosable purpose exclude restricted audit/legal copies from ordinary review. No-store is supplemented by explicit no browser/storage/log/public-render leakage rules; no-store alone is not privacy proof.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Status separation and finite reader amendment
reviewedAssessments.assessment: IF-BOOK-07 minimal projection and1024-byte ceiling stay separate. Proposed32768-byte read success/fixed<=1024 errors are expressly unmeasured ceilings. Sharing64 readers/one in-flight authorized context/ten starts per60 seconds/1024 keys and existing deadlines is an explicit prospective cross-route amendment; it is not silently asserted as already active. Exact ingress/limiter/store/output/cleanup, shared client coordination and authority-before-key allocation must be bound by the existing profile during canonical refinement.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Transport and observation failure
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Reuses same-origin booking GET proof/Origin/header restrictions, uniform non-disclosing denial, no validators/304/redirect/CORS and corrected bodyless HEAD behavior. Manual read/no timer/no automatic retry and epoch/context/authority-loss clearing are appropriate. Server/shape failure never supplies empty success or new mutation entitlement. Future exact response binding must preserve inherited object-independent refusals and current-authority output checks.

architectureAndFounderBoundary.decisionBeforeFurtherDefinition: No new founder choice is needed merely to correct LQR01 and further specify this reviewable candidate. Existing BF01 already requires the capability and the proposed GET preserves the accepted responsibility split, private purpose and existing resource meaning.
architectureAndFounderBoundary.requiredBeforeAdoption: The new logical interface and shared reader-profile amendment must remain proposed until their applicable independent review and integrated founder/API-contract acceptance. This receipt cannot release a new current-authority route, schema/handler work, provider capability or application endpoint. If refinement expands post-intent disclosure, questions/purpose/retention, provider effects or architecture/risk, stop that affected choice for founder decision.
